description: Add a chatbot system-prompt guardrail in the Render service so the bot NEVER hands developer/technical/integration instructions to the end user. Live bot has been replying with things like 'developer ko kaho ki <a href> HTML format me rakhe', 'react-linkify library use karo', 'Markdown renderer use karo', '[download: URL] parse karo'. Instead it should just present the link plainly and in a friendly, user-facing way in the user's language. This is INDEPENDENT of FEAT-001 (different files: mgmt/server-render). Update the preamble guardrail lines in mgmt/server-render/src/lib/publicData.js and the documentLinksBlock header, and add a Render test asserting the guardrail text is present.
steps: In mgmt/server-render/src/lib/publicData.js, add a single, clear guardrail sentence to the friendly-assistant preamble that is pushed in ALL THREE context builders so every provider/mode carries it: summarizePortalData (the `lines.push('Be generous and helpful: ...Only say you do not have the information...')` block, ~line 118), buildYearScopedContext (the same 'Be generous and helpful...' line, ~line 305), and buildFullContext (the 'Every person is shown by their real name. Only say you do not have...' line, ~line 382). The new sentence should say, in the existing friendly tone, something equivalent to: 'You are talking to an ordinary visitor, not a developer. NEVER give technical, developer, or integration instructions — do not mention HTML, Markdown, rendering, libraries (e.g. linkify), APIs, parsing, or how links should be displayed. When you reference a document, just present the link plainly and in a friendly, user-facing way in the user\'s language (e.g. "Yahan hai aapki 2024 ki receipt: <link>").' Keep wording consistent across the three call sites (define it once as a shared const string near the top of the module — e.g. NO_DEV_INSTRUCTIONS_LINE — and push that const in each builder, rather than copy-pasting drift-prone prose). Do NOT remove or weaken the existing 'Only say you do not have the information if it genuinely is not...' guardrail; add alongside it.

In documentLinksBlock, extend the existing header string (the one starting 'DOCUMENT LINKS (the user is asking about a receipt / certificate ...') so its instruction also tells the model to hand back the link plainly and to NOT give any developer/rendering/library/parse advice — reinforcing the preamble at the exact place links are surfaced. Keep the existing 'Yahan hai 2024 ki receipt: <link>' example and the 'Do NOT describe or open the PDF' clause.

Add/adjust a test in mgmt/server-render/test/publicChat.test.mjs (imports the pure fns already: summarizePortalData, buildFullContext, buildContextForProvider). Add a test asserting that the built context/prompt contains the no-developer-instructions guardrail — assert on a stable phrase from the new line (e.g. /NEVER give technical, developer, or integration instructions/ or a substring you choose, matched with assert.match) for BOTH summary mode (summarizePortalData(SAMPLE,'')) and full mode (buildFullContext(SAMPLE,'')), and that a document-intent question's context (a question containing 'receipt') carries the reinforced documentLinksBlock instruction. Do not weaken existing assertions; if any existing test asserts exact preamble text that your additive line would break, update that expectation to match the new prompt (additive line only — the existing sentences should be preserved verbatim, so most assertions should keep passing).
Run the Render suite: `cd mgmt/server-render && env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --test test/*.test.mjs` and confirm all pass (>=87 plus the new assertion). Confirm no test imports express or pg.
acceptance_criteria: All three context builders (summarizePortalData, buildYearScopedContext, buildFullContext) include the no-developer-instructions guardrail line, sourced from a single shared const so the wording cannot drift.
The guardrail explicitly forbids mentioning HTML/Markdown/rendering/libraries/APIs/parsing and instructs the bot to present links plainly and friendly in the user's language.
The documentLinksBlock header reinforces 'present the link plainly, no developer/rendering advice' while keeping its existing example and 'do not open the PDF' clause.
The existing 'only say you don't have it if genuinely absent' guardrail is preserved (not removed or weakened).

A Render test asserts the guardrail text is present in both summary and full prompts (and reinforced for document questions); `cd mgmt/server-render && env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --test test/*.test.mjs` passes with no import of express/pg.
verification: cd mgmt/server-render && env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --test test/*.test.mjs
findings: Added module-level const NO_DEV_INSTRUCTIONS_LINE near the top of mgmt/server-render/src/lib/publicData.js and pushed it in all three builders (summarizePortalData, buildYearScopedContext, buildFullContext) right after each builder's existing 'Reply briefly and clearly.' guardrail line, so wording cannot drift. Extended the documentLinksBlock header to add 'hand back the link ... plainly' and 'Give NO developer, rendering, library, or parsing advice ...' while keeping the existing 'Yahan hai 2024 ki receipt: <link>' example and 'Do NOT describe or open the PDF' clause. Existing 'Only say you do not have the information ...' guardrails preserved verbatim. Added one test in test/publicChat.test.mjs asserting the guardrail in summary + full modes and reinforcement in a receipt document-intent question. Render suite: 88 pass (87 baseline + 1 new), all green; node --check passes; no express/pg imports. REVIEW FOLLOW-UP (2026-09-12-061220-review): Fixed confirmed issue #2 (year-scoped guardrail unasserted) — buildYearScopedContext pushes NO_DEV_INSTRUCTIONS_LINE but no test asserted it there, so a partial revert of that one push would have passed CI. Added a test in test/publicChat.test.mjs that calls summarizePortalData(YEAR_SCOPED_SAMPLE, '2019 me total collection kitna tha?') — this routes through buildYearScopedContext because the question names a year present in the multi-year data (confirmed by asserting the year-scoping preamble and year-only totals) — and asserts the guardrail line ('NEVER give technical, developer, or integration instructions' plus the 'do not mention HTML, Markdown, rendering, libraries (e.g. linkify), APIs, parsing' phrase) is present on that branch. No publicData.js change was needed for this issue (the line was already pushed correctly; the gap was test-only). Render suite now 89 pass / 0 fail; no express/pg imports.
